FAVORABLE.headline: Weather conditions are favorable for disease development.

PARTIALLY_FAVORABLE.headline: Some weather conditions may support disease development.

NOT_FAVORABLE_BY_QUANTIFIED_RULES.headline: Current weather does not match the quantified favorable conditions used by this disease model.

WETNESS_PROXY_AVAILABLE_DIRECT_MODEL_NOT.headline: Wet-weather conditions are present, but the full disease model cannot be run because direct leaf-wetness duration is unavailable.

ENVIRONMENTAL_FACTORS_AVAILABLE_DISEASE_.headline: Weather factors relevant to this disease are available, but current evidence is insufficient for a numerical risk classification.

INSUFFICIENT_FOR_NUMERIC_MODEL.headline: Additional field or disease-history information is required for a stronger assessment.

WEATHER_CONTEXT_ONLY_INCIDENCE_HISTORY_M.headline: Weather information is available, but recent disease history is required before this model can be applied.

BOLLWORM_DETECTED_SPECIES_CONFIRMATION_R.headline: Bollworm activity was identified, but the species must be confirmed before species-specific forecasting is used.

PREVENTION_ONLY.headline: No active disease treatment forecast is required. Continue routine prevention and monitoring.

NOT_FAVORABLE_BY_REPORTED_RANGE.headline: The main weather conditions reported as favorable for this disease are not currently matched.

TEMPERATURE_FAVORABLE_QUALITATIVE_SUPPOR.headline: Temperature is within the reported favorable range for this disease. Humidity and rainfall may provide additional support, so continued monitoring is advised.

TEMPERATURE_NOT_IN_REPORTED_FAVORABLE_RA.headline: Temperature is outside the reported favorable range for this disease, although field monitoring should continue.

MOISTURE_PROXY_AVAILABLE_FULL_FAST_MODEL.headline: Rainfall or high humidity may support early blight development, but the full disease model cannot be run because direct leaf-wetness duration is unavailable.

MOISTURE_PRESSURE_INDICATORS_AVAILABLE_F.headline: Moisture-related weather conditions are present, but the complete late blight infection model cannot be executed without the required direct disease-model inputs.

FAVORABLE_ENVIRONMENT.headline: Temperature and humidity are within reported conditions that may support leaf mold development.

HIGHLY_FAVORABLE_ENVIRONMENT.headline: Temperature and humidity closely match reported conditions that strongly support leaf mold development.
